profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at General Motors
profile.summary:
Senior Backend Software Engineer | Java | Spring | Go | AWS | Azure | Kubernetes
Results-driven software engineer passionate about building scalable, high-performance backend systems in cloud environments. Strong interest in distributed computing, microservices, and application scalability. Skilled in designing and implementing backend services using Java, Golang, and AWS and Azure technologies.
Holds a Master’s degree in Computer Science from the University of North Carolina at Charlotte, with a strong foundation in algorithms, system design, and concurrency.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.insights: Microsoft Azure, Spring Boot and +5 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Contributed to backend development for the Vonage Video API platform, building and maintaining
scalable REST API components using Java, Jeresey, Spring boot, Go, Node.js, and Python, handling over 60 million API requests daily.
● Ensured platform scalability and performance by leveraging Amazon RDS MySQL, Amazon
Elasticache, and Amazon EKS
● Optimised platform scalability during the COVID-19 surge, migrating from INAP to AWS, which resulted
in a 30% performance improvement during peak usage periods.
● Integrated the Video API platform with Nexmo’s Voice and SMS services within three months,
generating $2M+ in new customer opportunities.
● Developed the Vonage AI speech connector using Quarkus for real-time transcription of publisher audio
in video sessions.
● Implemented a quota-limit feature, reducing API downtime incidents and ensuring platform stability
under heavy usage.
● Created a Go-based script to automate the addition of session monitoring events for existing Video API customers, reducing manual integration time by 100%.
● Integrated Micrometer-Prometheus alerts, developed 20+ Grafana and Kibana dashboards, and
improved system observability and monitoring
● Collaborated with cross-functional teams across Spain, London, and India and
and knowledge shared with new members.
● Awarded the Vonage Key Contributor Award (2020 and 2024) for exceptional contributions to
platform performance and customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Working as a full stack engineer to automate the manual onboarding process of new hires joining the company
• Designed and developed the UI of mobile and web app using Android, NodeJS, Angular, MongoDB and AWS
• Contributing to the full mobile application development lifecycle from planning, requirement gathering, development and testing of the android version of the application by using Android Studio and 3rd party libraries

positions.title: Senior Applications Engineer
positions.description:
• Part of the development of Oracle Sales Cloud Automotive Industry solution from its requirement gathering phase
• Designed and implemented Automotive industry specific requirements using ADF, Java, JSF, XML and Groovy
• Followed Agile Methodologies for Project development and acted as scrum master when the manager is on vacation
• Created a tool for generating a localized sales method package for customers using UNIX bash scripting
• Wrote SQL queries for KPI dashboards and reports for different user roles in OBIEE 
• Automated the process of downloading the customization in an environment using Java and Selenium WebDriver
• Collaborated with different product managers and maintained good communication with the different team 
   across multiple locations around the globe.
• Provided technical and functional training to the new members joined the team.

positions.title: Application Engineer
positions.description:
• Part of the development of Hitech and Manufacturing industry solution from its requirement gathering phase
• Designed and implemented industry specific requirements using ADF, Java, JSF, XML, SQL and Groovy Script
• Devised one-off solutions for customers by discussing requirements, designing implementation algorithms, coding
   and testing the solution and providing post-implementation support as part of a 4-member team 
• Automated the process of environment setup and maintenance which reduced the manual effort and time

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
• Involved in the development and bug fixing of Oracle CRM on Demand (SaaS) application
• Developed debugging skills by resolving customer bugs using JAVA, C++, JavaScript, PL/SQL and Siebel Tool

projects.title: Bike Sharing - Linear Regression
projects.description:
• Built Linear regression model for bike sharing dataset using Least Square and Least Means square methods.
• Exploratory data analysis on Bike Sharing dataset.
• Python, Jupyter Notebook

projects.title: GBN & SR Protocol Simulation: Computer Communication & Networks
projects.description: Simulated Go-Back-N and Selective Repeat Protocols using an unreliable channel(UDP) using Java. Simulated checksum error, packet loss, acknowledgment loss and timeout conditions for both protocols.
